description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [100% Critical], [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Ex-SOLDIER Mode I (Cloud)] and [Dark Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Ex-SOLDIER Mode I (Cloud)
description.text: Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Darkness Rush after using Dark abilities (max 3)

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Ex-SOLDIER Mode II (Cloud)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Ex-SOLDIER Mode II (Cloud)
description.text: Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Dark abilities, grants [Deadly Strikes +20% 3] to the user after using Dark abilities, grants [Quick Cast 3] and [Attach Dark] to the user after using Dark abilities if Sephiroth is alive

description.name: Deadly Strikes +20% 3
description.text: Critical hits deal 20% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Dual Darkness Rush
description.text: Three single attacks (0.67 each), 100% hit rate, grants [Heavy Charge +2] to the user

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3
